$comment: Generated by tools/generate-placeholder-images.mjs. Do not hand edit.
Every asset is EXACTLY the dimensions and EXACTLY the byte weight its slot is allowed
by the M1 performance budget, so a page measured against these placeholders is measured
against the weight real photography will carry.
Every asset is stamped PLACEHOLDER and NOT REAL CONTENT in readable type.
budgetSource: M1 deliverable, per-page byte and speed budget, section 4, and its budget.json

format.note: PNG. The production pipeline serves AVIF with a WebP fallback. PNG is used here because these files are generated with the Node standard library and no native image codec, which keeps them reproducible on any machine with no install step. What the budget measures is bytes on the wire and pixel dimensions, and both are exact. The one thing a PNG placeholder does not reproduce is AVIF decode cost, which is the smaller half of the hero cost line (50 ms of the 385 ms) and is measured for real the moment the first genuine photograph is processed.
